name: model
description: Set the default Copilot CLI model, or auto to let Copilot select an available model.

examples.explanation: Let Copilot choose the default model for new sessions.

when_to_use: Use to persist automatic or explicit model selection across sessions.
when_not_to_use: Use --model or /model for a one-session change.

conditions: Available models depend on account and organization policy.

name: sandbox.enabled
description: Persist OS-level sandboxing for shell commands, local MCP and language servers, and built-in file and web tools.

examples.explanation: Enable the sandbox for future sessions by default.

when_to_use: Use to make shell and local tool isolation the normal session posture.

conditions: Sandbox functionality is available in experimental mode; managed policy can enforce a minimum sandbox floor.

name: worktreeBaseRef
description: Choose whether new Copilot worktrees branch from the current checkout or the remote default branch.

examples.explanation: Base new isolated worktrees on the remote default branch.

when_to_use: Use defaultBranch when new worktrees should not inherit unrelated commits from the current checkout.

conditions: Applies to the experimental /worktree and --worktree controls.
